If sentiment is strongly positive (≥0.8) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is strongly negative (≤-0.8) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to offset pessimism.  
In mid-horizon (8–15 days), if sentiment is neutral (0.2–0.8), apply a 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment if recent price trend is declining.  
In late-horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is positive but price is trending downward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% to align with momentum reversal.  
If sentiment is positive but forecast is consistently above true price by >3%, apply a 1.0–2.0% downward correction in late horizon to prevent overfitting.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is consistently below true price by >3%, apply a 1.0–2.0% upward correction in late horizon to avoid underestimation.
